title: TeleNeo Typeface
slide_intent: Explain how letter construction and weight affect voice and readability so designers select the face deliberately.
strategic_value: Brush-like details, precise terminals and clear numerals can support T-Mobile’s combination of human warmth and technical clarity.
demonstration: Six upright weights and six italic counterparts are displayed in two specimen columns beside usage guidance.
practical_value: Select an approved upright weight; distinguish the complete family inventory from the subset permitted in creative.

content_islands.name: Typeface rules and anatomy
content_islands.spec: List usage limits and the three construction qualities in the left column.

content_islands.name: Upright specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack thin through ultra with letters, numerals and punctuation in the middle column.

content_islands.name: Italic inventory
content_islands.spec: Align the six italic specimens opposite their upright counterparts for reference.

ingredient.name: TeleNeo weight
ingredient.role: Set message emphasis and preserve clear letterforms.
ingredient.application: Use TeleNeo for external communications; reserve Ultra for short messages at least 14 pt. Italics are not approved for creative executions.
ingredient.scope: Web, apps and legal copy may substitute Arial or another system font.
